scanNote:
1-UNITNING TO'RTINCHI BETI (9-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda to'q sariq yorliqda oq '1'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Reading & Listening' sarlavhasi.
16) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Read the questions and circle the correct item. Then, listen and check your answers.' Oltita savol, har birida A va B variantlari.
17) 'Read the letter and match the headings to the paragraphs.' Olti sarlavha va nuqtali joylar: Food; Location/Accommodation; People (Looks/Character); Plans; Weather/Sights/Activities; Recommendation.
18) 'Underline the phrases in the letter which best describe the pictures, then explain the words in bold.'
19) 'Fill in the correct word from the list, then make sentences using them.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: smoked, thick, fantastic, quiet, historic, spectacular. Olti nuqtali qator: 1 a ... time; 2 a ... hotel; 3 a ... view; 4 ... snow; 5 ... waters; 6 ... salmon.

O'NG TOMONDA to'rtta surat (polaroid uslubida, oq ramkali):
• a - Bergendagi yog'och binolar, oldida qizil gullar; ustida yozuv 'Royal Hotel'
• b - Bergen bandargohi: baland machtali yelkanli kema, orqada rangli yog'och uylar; yozuv 'The harbour at Bergen'
• c - tog' yonbag'rida yurgan bir necha sayyoh (piyoda yurish)
• d - fyord: tik qoyalar orasidagi sokin suv va oq kruiz kemasi; yozuv 'Fjords'

Suratlar ostida yirtilgan qog'oz shaklidagi XAT:
'Dear Mum and Dad,' - so'ng olti xatboshi, har birining oldida to'q sariq raqamli strelka (1-6). Xat oxirida 'Love, Susan'.
Qalin harfli so'zlar: stunning, past, waterfalls, the outdoors, tend to be, especially, shrimps, lobster, caviar, smoked salmon, looking forward, receive, get home.

20) 'In pairs, ask and answer questions based on the letter, as in the example.' Ikki ustunli ko'k qiya namuna dialog.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Writing (Project)': 'Imagine you are at a holiday resort. Write a letter to your pen-friend about the location of the place, your accommodation, the weather, the sights, your activities, the people there, the food and your plans. End the letter by recommending the place to your pen-friend. Use the letter above as a model.' (ko'k harflar bilan berilgan qismlar)

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '9'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the questions and circle the correct item. Then, listen and check your answers.
exercises.instructionUz: Savollarni o'qing va to'g'ri variantni aylantiring. So'ng tinglang va javoblaringizni tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR XATDA BOR.

  ⚠ Kassetada shu xat o'qiladi - ya'ni
  bu mashqni AUDIOSIZ ham to'liq
  bajarish mumkin.

  ⚠ Kitob ataylab shunday tuzgan:
  avval TAXMIN qilasiz, keyin
  ESHITIB TEKShIRASIZ. Bu usul
  'predict and check' deb ataladi.


XAT HAQIDA:

  Kim yozgan:  Susan
  Kimga:       ota-onasiga
  Qayerdan:    Bergen, Norvegiya
  Kim bilan:   Lee bilan

  ⚠ Lee - 6-betdagi manikyurchi
  emas, boshqa odam (kitobda ism
  takrorlangan).


⚠ 'TO CIRCLE':

  = aylantirib belgilamoq.
  ⚠ 'a circle' (ot) = doira
  ⚠ 'to circle' (fe'l) = aylana chizmoq


⚠ 'AN ITEM':

  = band, dona, variant.
  Mashqlarda: 'circle the correct ITEM'
  = to'g'ri variantni belgilang.

items.whyUz:
Xatda: 'I'm so happy to be here in BERGEN
for our holidays ... this part of NORWAY.'

⚠ Bergen - Norvegiyaning ikkinchi katta shahri.

Xatda: 'Lee and I are staying at the historic
Royal Hotel.'

⚠ 'to stay AT a hotel' - predlog 'at'.
⚠ 'to stay IN a flat' - predlog 'in'.
items.textEn: Where are she and Lee staying?

items.whyUz:
Xatda: 'We spend most of our days HIKING IN
THE MOUNTAINS with our Norwegian friends.'

⚠ 'to spend time DOING sth' - keyin -ING shakli.
items.textEn: How do they spend most of their days?

items.whyUz:
Xatda: 'They're very FRIENDLY AND KIND to us.'

⚠ 'What ARE they LIKE?' - XARAKTER savoli
('look like' emas!).

Xatda: 'Norwegians like eating FISH and seafood,
especially salmon, shrimps, lobster and caviar.'

items.uz: Syuzan va Li keyingi hafta qayerga borishmoqda?
items.whyUz:
Xatda: 'Next week we're going to OSLO.'

⚠ 'are going' - PRESENT CONTINUOUS kelasi
zamon ma'nosida (rejalashtirilgan ish).
items.textEn: Where are Susan and Lee going next week?

exercises.instructionEn: Dear Mum and Dad, ... Love, Susan
exercises.instructionUz: Hurmatli oyi va dadam, ... Mehr bilan, Syuzan
exercises.explanationUz:
XATNING TO'LIQ MATNI VA TARJIMASI
bandlarda berilgan.


⚠ NORASMIY XATNING TUZILIShI:

  1) Murojaat: 'Dear Mum and Dad,'
     ⚠ Vergul bilan tugaydi.
     ⚠ 'Mum' va 'Dad' KATTA harf bilan,
     chunki bu yerda ular ISM o'rnida.

  2) Kirish: qayerdaman, qanday
     his qilyapman

  3) Asosiy qism: joy, ob-havo, odamlar,
     ovqat, rejalar

  4) Yakun: tavsiya + 'See you soon.'

  5) Imzo: 'Love, Susan'
     ⚠ Yaqin odamlarga 'Love,'.
     ⚠ Do'stlarga 'Best wishes,'.
     ⚠ Rasmiy xatda 'Yours sincerely,'.


⚠ OLTI XATBOShI - OLTI MAVZU:

  1  Joylashuv va turar joy
  2  Ob-havo, manzaralar, mashg'ulotlar
  3  Odamlar (qiyofa va xarakter)
  4  Ovqat
  5  Rejalar
  6  Tavsiya

  ⚠ Bu tartib 17-mashqning javobi va
  aynan shu tartibda siz ham xat
  yozasiz (Writing Project).


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR:

  stunning      = hayratlanarli darajada
                  go'zal
  past          = yonidan o'tib
  a waterfall   = sharshara
  the outdoors  = ochiq havo, tabiat
  tend to be    = odatda ... bo'ladi
  especially    = ayniqsa
  a shrimp      = krevetka
  a lobster     = omar
  caviar        = ikra
  smoked salmon = dudlangan losos
  looking forward = intiqlik bilan kutmoq
  to receive    = olmoq (qabul qilmoq)
  to get home   = uyga yetib bormoq

points.noteUz:
⚠ Murojaatdan keyin VERGUL (nuqta emas).

⚠ 'Mum' (Britaniya) - 'Mom' (AQSh).
⚠ Bu yerda ISM o'rnida ishlatilgani uchun
KATTA harf bilan.

points.en: I'm so happy to be here in Bergen for our holidays. I'm having a fantastic time and I just love this part of Norway.
points.uz: Ta'tilimizda shu yerda, Bergenda ekanimdan juda xursandman. Ajoyib vaqt o'tkazyapman va Norvegiyaning bu qismini juda yaxshi ko'raman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to have a fantastic time' = ajoyib vaqt
o'tkazmoq. 'have' bu yerda CONTINUOUS shaklda
bo'lishi mumkin, chunki 'egalik' ma'nosida emas.

⚠ 'holidays' - Britaniyada ta'til.
AQShda 'vacation'.

points.en: Lee and I are staying at the historic Royal Hotel.
points.uz: Li bilan men tarixiy Royal mehmonxonasida turibmiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'Lee and I' - EGA bo'lgani uchun 'I'
('me' emas).
⚠ Odob qoidasi: o'zingizni OXIRIDA aytasiz.

⚠ 'to stay AT a hotel' - predlog 'at'.

points.en: At the moment we are having a cup of hot chocolate and enjoying the spectacular view of the harbour.
points.uz: Ayni damda issiq shokolad ichib, bandargohning ajoyib manzaridan bahra olyapmiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'at the moment' = ayni damda - PRESENT
CONTINUOUS ning belgisi.

⚠ 'a view OF sth' - predlog 'of'.
⚠ 'a harbour' = bandargoh (AQSh: 'harbor').

points.en: The weather is cold, and perfect for skiing. The seven mountains around the city are covered in thick snow.
points.uz: Havo sovuq va chang'i uchish uchun juda mos. Shahar atrofidagi yettita tog' qalin qor bilan qoplangan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'perfect FOR' + -ING: 'perfect for SKIING'.
⚠ 'covered IN/WITH snow' - ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

⚠ Bergen 'the city of seven mountains' deb
ataladi.

points.en: The famous fjords are stunning. In these quiet waters you can sail past mountains, waterfalls and fields.
points.uz: Mashhur fyordlar hayratlanarli darajada go'zal. Bu sokin suvlarda tog'lar, sharsharalar va dalalar yonidan suzib o'tish mumkin.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a fjord' - norveg so'zi: tog'lar orasidagi
tor dengiz ko'rfazi.
⚠ 'stunning' = hayratlanarli go'zal ('to stun' =
hang qoldirmoq).
⚠ 'past' bu yerda PREDLOG: 'yonidan o'tib'.

points.en: We spend most of our days hiking in the mountains with our Norwegian friends, Erik and Katerina.
points.uz: Kunlarimizning ko'pini norvegiyalik do'stlarimiz Erik va Katerina bilan tog'da piyoda yurib o'tkazamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to spend time DOING sth' - keyin -ING.
⚠ 'to hike' = uzoq piyoda sayr qilmoq.

⚠ 'Norwegian' - millat sifati, KATTA harf bilan.

points.en: Norwegians really love the outdoors. They're very friendly and kind to us.
points.uz: Norvegiyaliklar tabiatni juda yaxshi ko'radi. Ular bizga juda samimiy va mehribon.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'the outdoors' - HAR DOIM 'the' bilan va
KO'PLIK shaklda: ochiq havo, tabiat.

⚠ 'kind TO sb' - predlog 'to'.

points.en: I think they're really good-looking. Most of them tend to be tall, with fair hair and light blue eyes.
points.uz: Menimcha, ular haqiqatan chiroyli. Ularning ko'pi baland bo'yli, oq-sariq sochli va och ko'k ko'zli bo'ladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'tend to be' = odatda ... bo'ladi.
Umumlashtirishni YUMShATADI - 'hammasi'
demaslik uchun.

⚠ 'most of them' - 'of' bilan, chunki
olmoshdan oldin.

points.en: The food is delicious. Norwegians like eating fish and seafood, especially salmon, shrimps, lobster and caviar.
points.uz: Ovqat mazali. Norvegiyaliklar baliq va dengiz mahsulotlarini, ayniqsa losos, krevetka, omar va ikrani yeyishni yaxshi ko'radi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'especially' = ayniqsa. Imlosiga diqqat:
ikkita 'l'.

⚠ 'salmon' - 'l' harfi O'QILMAYDI: 'semon'.

points.en: I just love eating fresh bread and smoked salmon for lunch.
points.uz: Tushlikka yangi non va dudlangan losos yeyishni juda yaxshi ko'raman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'smoked' = dudlangan ('smoke' = tutun).
⚠ 'FOR lunch' - ovqat mahali oldidan 'for'.

⚠ 'bread' - SANALMAYDIGAN ot.

points.en: Next week we're going to Oslo. I can't wait to visit the Outdoor Folk Museum.
points.uz: Keyingi hafta Osloga boramiz. Ochiq havodagi Xalq muzeyiga borishni intiqlik bilan kutyapman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'we're going' - PRESENT CONTINUOUS kelasi
zamon ma'nosida (rejalashtirilgan ish).

⚠ "I can't wait to ..." = sabrsizlik bilan
kutmoq. Turg'un ibora.

points.en: Lee is not so keen, but I'm looking forward to it.
points.uz: Li unchalik ishtiyoqli emas, lekin men buni intiqlik bilan kutyapman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'keen' = ishtiyoqli. 'keen ON sth' = qiziqmoq.

⚠ 'to look forward TO' - bu yerda 'to' PREDLOG,
shuning uchun keyin -ING yoki OT keladi:
'looking forward to IT', 'looking forward to
SEEING you'.

points.en: Our flight is leaving from Oslo next Friday, so I hope you'll receive this before we get home!
points.uz: Reysimiz kelasi juma kuni Oslodan jo'naydi, shuning uchun buni biz uyga yetib borgunimizcha olasiz deb umid qilaman!
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to receive' - imlo qoidasi: 'C' dan keyin
'EI' ('i before e except after c').

⚠ 'to get home' - predlogsiz! 'get TO home'
XATO ('home' bu yerda RAVISh).

points.en: I think you should come here next year. I'm sure you would love it! See you soon. Love, Susan
points.uz: Menimcha, kelasi yili bu yerga kelishingiz kerak. Ishonchim komil, sizga juda yoqadi! Tez orada ko'rishguncha. Mehr bilan, Syuzan
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'should' = maslahat berish.
⚠ 'would love' - shartli mayl, taklifni
YUMShATADI.

⚠ 'Love,' - eng yaqin odamlarga.
⚠ Xat oxirida imzo VERGUL bilan ajratiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the letter and match the headings to the paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Xatni o'qing va sarlavhalarni xatboshilarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
XATBOShI = BITTA FIKR.

  ⚠ Yaxshi yozilgan xatda har xatboshi
  BITTA mavzuga bag'ishlanadi. Shuning
  uchun sarlavhani topish oson: xatboshining
  BIRINChI gapini o'qish yetadi.

  ⚠ Bu 'topic sentence' deb ataladi -
  xatboshining asosiy gapi.


TO'G'RI TARTIB:

  1-xatboshi → Location/Accommodation
  2-xatboshi → Weather/Sights/Activities
  3-xatboshi → People (Looks/Character)
  4-xatboshi → Food
  5-xatboshi → Plans
  6-xatboshi → Recommendation

  ⚠ Bu tartib Writing Project topshirig'ida
  ham AYNAN takrorlanadi.


⚠ 'ACCOMMODATION':

  = turar joy, yashash sharoiti.
  ⚠ Imlosi qiyin: IKKI 'c' va IKKI 'm'.
  ⚠ Britaniyada SANALMAYDIGAN ot:
  'accommodations' - AQSh varianti.


⚠ 'A RECOMMENDATION':

  = tavsiya.
  ⚠ 'to recommend' = tavsiya qilmoq.
  ⚠ Imlosi: BITTA 'c', IKKI 'm'.
  ('accommodation' bilan adashtirmang!)

pairs.whyUz:
1-xatboshi: 'I'm so happy to be here in Bergen ...
Lee and I are staying at the historic Royal Hotel.'

⚠ 'accommodation' - imlosi: IKKI 'c', IKKI 'm'.

2-xatboshi: 'The weather is cold ... The famous
fjords are stunning ... We spend most of our days
hiking.'

3-xatboshi: 'Norwegians really love the outdoors.
They're very friendly and kind ... Most of them
tend to be tall.'

4-xatboshi: 'The food is delicious. Norwegians
like eating fish and seafood.'

5-xatboshi: 'Next week we're going to Oslo ...
Our flight is leaving from Oslo next Friday.'

6-xatboshi: 'I think you should come here next
year. I'm sure you would love it!'

⚠ 'to recommend' = tavsiya qilmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the phrases in the letter which best describe the pictures, then explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Xatdagi suratlarni eng yaxshi tasvirlaydigan iboralar tagiga chizing, so'ng qalin harfli so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
SURATNI MATN BILAN BOG'LASh.

  ⚠ To'rtta surat: a, b, c, d.

  ⚠ Bu mashq xatni IKKINChI MARTA
  o'qishga majbur qiladi - takroriy
  o'qish so'zlarni yodda qoldiradi.


QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLARNING MA'NOSI:

  stunning      = hayratlanarli go'zal
  past          = yonidan o'tib (predlog)
  a waterfall   = sharshara
  the outdoors  = ochiq havo, tabiat
  tend to be    = odatda ... bo'ladi
  especially    = ayniqsa
  a shrimp      = krevetka
  a lobster     = omar
  caviar        = ikra
  smoked salmon = dudlangan losos
  to look forward to = intiqlik bilan kutmoq
  to receive    = olmoq
  to get home   = uyga yetib bormoq


⚠ 'PAST' - UCh XIL SO'Z:

  1) PREDLOG: 'sail PAST mountains'
     = tog'lar yonidan suzib o'tmoq
  2) OT: 'in the past' = o'tmishda
  3) SIFAT: 'past simple' = o'tgan zamon


⚠ 'SHRIMP' va 'PRAWN':

  AQShda 'shrimp', Britaniyada ko'proq
  'prawn' (kattaroq krevetka).

pairs.whyUz:
1-xatboshidan: 'Lee and I are staying at the
HISTORIC ROYAL HOTEL.'

⚠ 'historic' = tarixiy ahamiyatga ega.
'historical' = tarixga oid (kitob, film).

pairs.right: the spectacular view of the harbour
pairs.whyUz:
1-xatboshidan: 'enjoying the SPECTACULAR VIEW
OF THE HARBOUR'.

⚠ 'spectacular' = ko'zni qamashtiradigan.

pairs.left: c - people hiking in the mountains
pairs.whyUz:
2-xatboshidan: 'We spend most of our days
HIKING IN THE MOUNTAINS.'

⚠ 'to hike' = uzoq masofaga piyoda sayr.

pairs.right: The famous fjords are stunning. In these quiet waters you can sail past mountains.
pairs.rightUz: Mashhur fyordlar hayratlanarli go'zal. Bu sokin suvlarda tog'lar yonidan suzib o'tish mumkin.
pairs.whyUz:
2-xatboshidan.

⚠ 'a fjord' - norvegcha so'z: tog'lar orasidagi
tor dengiz ko'rfazi.
⚠ 'stunning' = hang qoldiradigan darajada go'zal.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct word from the list, then make sentences using them.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan to'g'ri so'zni qo'ying, so'ng ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
YANA COLLOCATION MAShQI.

  ⚠ Hamma ibora XATDA bor - qidirib
  toping.


⚠ NIMA UChUN 1-3 DA 'a' BOR,
4-6 DA YO'Q:

  1  a fantastic time  - 'time' bu yerda
     SANALADIGAN ('vaqt o'tkazish')
  2  a historic hotel  - sanaladigan
  3  a spectacular view - sanaladigan

  4  thick snow    - 'snow' SANALMAYDIGAN
  5  quiet waters  - KO'PLIK
  6  smoked salmon - 'salmon' bu yerda
     ovqat, SANALMAYDIGAN


⚠ 'A HISTORIC' va 'AN HISTORIC':

  Zamonaviy inglizchada 'A historic'
  (h o'qiladi).
  ⚠ Eski kitoblarda 'AN historic' ham
  uchraydi - ikkalasi ham qabul qilinadi.


⚠ 'WATERS' - KO'PLIKDA:

  'water' odatda SANALMAYDIGAN.
  Lekin 'waters' (ko'plikda) = suv
  hududi, dengiz suvlari.

  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'sands' (qumliklar),
  'snows' (qorlar) - she'riy uslubda.


⚠ 'THICK':

  = qalin. 'thick snow', 'thick hair',
  'thick book'.
  ⚠ Aksi: 'thin' = yupqa, ozg'in.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, ask and answer questions based on the letter, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda xat asosida savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  SA: Where is Susan?
  SB: In Bergen, Norway.
  SA: Where are they staying?
  SB: At the historic Royal Hotel.

  ⚠ Javoblar TO'LIQ GAP emas - qisqa.
  Bu tabiiy og'zaki nutq.


⚠ SAVOL SO'ZLARI:

  Where  - qayerda / qayerga
  What   - nima
  Who    - kim
  How    - qanday
  When   - qachon
  Why    - nima uchun


⚠ SAVOLDA SO'Z TARTIBI:

  Savol so'zi + yordamchi fe'l + ega +
     asosiy fe'l

  'Where ARE they STAYING?'
  'What DO Norwegians LIKE eating?'

  ⚠ 'to be' bilan yordamchi kerak emas:
  'Where IS Susan?'

items.question: Where is Susan?
items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. Javob QISQA - to'liq gap emas.

items.question: Where are they staying?
items.whyUz:
Kitobdagi namuna.

⚠ 'to stay AT a hotel' - predlog 'at'.

items.question: What is the weather like?
items.answer: It's cold and perfect for skiing.
items.whyUz:
⚠ "What's the weather LIKE?" - ob-havoni
so'rashning asosiy qolipi.
⚠ 'How is the weather?' ham to'g'ri, lekin
kamroq ishlatiladi.

items.question: How do they spend their days?
items.answer: They spend most of their days hiking in the mountains.

items.question: What do Norwegians look like?
items.answer: Most of them tend to be tall, with fair hair and light blue eyes.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'look like' - TAShQI QIYoFA.
⚠ 'tend to be' umumlashtirishni yumshatadi.

items.question: What do they like eating?
items.answer: They like eating fish and seafood, especially salmon.

items.question: Where are they going next week?
items.whyUz:
⚠ PRESENT CONTINUOUS kelasi zamon ma'nosida -
rejalashtirilgan ish.

items.question: When is their flight leaving?
items.answer: It's leaving from Oslo next Friday.

exercises.instructionEn: Imagine you are at a holiday resort. Write a letter to your pen-friend about the location of the place, your accommodation, the weather, the sights, your activities, the people there, the food and your plans. End the letter by recommending the place to your pen-friend. Use the letter above as a model.
exercises.instructionUz: Tasavvur qiling, siz dam olish maskanidasiz. Qalamkash do'stingizga joyning joylashuvi, turar joyingiz, ob-havo, manzaralar, mashg'ulotlaringiz, u yerdagi odamlar, ovqat va rejalaringiz haqida xat yozing. Xatni do'stingizga shu joyni tavsiya qilib yakunlang. Yuqoridagi xatni namuna qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
NORASMIY XAT - LOYIHA IShI.

  ⚠ Susanning xati AYNAN NAMUNA:
  uning tuzilishini takrorlang.


XATNING SKELETI:

  Dear [ism],

  1) Joylashuv va turar joy
     'I'm so happy to be here in ...
      I'm staying at ...'

  2) Ob-havo, manzaralar, mashg'ulotlar
     'The weather is ...
      The ... are stunning.
      We spend most of our days ...ing.'

  3) Odamlar
     'The people here are very ...
      Most of them tend to be ...'

  4) Ovqat
     'The food is delicious.
      They like eating ..., especially ...'

  5) Rejalar
     'Next week we're going to ...
      I can't wait to ...'

  6) Tavsiya
     'I think you should come here ...
      I'm sure you would love it!'

  See you soon.

  Love,
  [ismingiz]


⚠ ENG MUHIM QOIDA:

  Har xatboshi BITTA mavzuga
  bag'ishlansin. Bu - 17-mashqning
  butun ma'nosi.


⚠ 'A PEN-FRIEND':

  = qalamkash do'st (xat yozib turadigan).
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'pen-friend',
  AQShda 'pen pal'.


⚠ 'A RESORT':

  = dam olish maskani (dengiz bo'yi,
  tog' kurorti).


⚠ NORASMIY XATDA QISQARTMA IShLATING:

  I'm, we're, don't, can't, I'll
  ⚠ Rasmiy xatda esa TO'LIQ shakl.

  ⚠ Susanning xatida hamma joyda
  qisqartma bor - chunki u
  OTA-ONASIGA yozyapti.
exercises.example:
Dear Alex,

I'm so happy to be here in Antalya for our holidays. I'm having a fantastic time and I just love this part of Turkey. We are staying at a modern seaside hotel. At the moment we are having a cup of tea and enjoying the spectacular view of the sea.

The weather is hot and perfect for swimming. The old town and the ancient ruins are stunning. We spend most of our days walking along the beach and visiting museums.

The people here really love their city. They're very friendly and kind to us. Most of them tend to be dark-haired, with brown eyes.

The food is delicious. Turkish people like eating grilled meat and vegetables, especially kebabs. I just love eating fresh bread and olives for breakfast.

Next week we're going to Istanbul. I can't wait to visit the Blue Mosque. Our flight is leaving next Sunday, so I hope you'll receive this before we get home!

I think you should come here next year. I'm sure you would love it!
See you soon.

Love,
Malika
exercises.exampleUz:
Hurmatli Aleks,

Ta'tilimizda shu yerda, Antalyada ekanimdan juda xursandman. Ajoyib vaqt o'tkazyapman va Turkiyaning bu qismini juda yaxshi ko'raman. Biz dengiz bo'yidagi zamonaviy mehmonxonada turibmiz. Ayni damda choy ichib, dengizning ajoyib manzarasidan bahra olyapmiz.

Havo issiq va suzish uchun juda mos. Eski shahar va qadimiy xarobalar hayratlanarli go'zal. Kunlarimizning ko'pini plyaj bo'ylab sayr qilib va muzeylarga borib o'tkazamiz.

Bu yerdagi odamlar o'z shahrini juda yaxshi ko'radi. Ular bizga juda samimiy va mehribon. Ko'pchiligi qora sochli, jigarrang ko'zli bo'ladi.

Ovqat mazali. Turklar qovurilgan go'sht va sabzavotni, ayniqsa kabobni yeyishni yaxshi ko'radi. Nonushtaga yangi non va zaytun yeyishni juda yaxshi ko'raman.

Keyingi hafta Istanbulga boramiz. Ko'k masjidga borishni intiqlik bilan kutyapman. Reysimiz kelasi yakshanba kuni jo'naydi, shuning uchun buni biz uyga yetib borgunimizcha olasiz deb umid qilaman!

Menimcha, kelasi yili bu yerga kelishing kerak. Ishonchim komil, senga juda yoqadi!
Tez orada ko'rishguncha.

Mehr bilan,
Malika

patterns.formula: I'm so happy to be here in [joy].
patterns.exampleEn: I'm so happy to be here in Bergen for our holidays.
patterns.exampleUz: Ta'tilimizda shu yerda, Bergenda ekanimdan juda xursandman.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Xatning ochilish gapi.
⚠ 'happy TO BE' - sifatdan keyin infinitiv.

patterns.exampleEn: We are staying at the historic Royal Hotel.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'stay AT a hotel' (nuqta sifatida)
⚠ 'stay IN a flat' (ichida)

patterns.formula: We spend most of our days [-ING].
patterns.exampleEn: We spend most of our days hiking in the mountains.
patterns.exampleUz: Kunlarimizning ko'pini tog'da piyoda yurib o'tkazamiz.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to spend time DOING sth' - keyin HAR DOIM -ING.
⚠ 'spend time TO DO' - XATO.

patterns.formula: Most of them tend to be [sifat].
patterns.exampleEn: Most of them tend to be tall, with fair hair.
patterns.exampleUz: Ularning ko'pi baland bo'yli, oq-sariq sochli bo'ladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'tend to be' umumlashtirishni YUMShATADI -
'hammasi' demaslik uchun juda foydali qolip.

patterns.exampleEn: I'm looking forward to visiting the museum.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Bu yerda 'to' - PREDLOG, fe'l belgisi EMAS!
Shuning uchun keyin -ING keladi.
⚠ 'looking forward to visit' - XATO.

patterns.formula: I think you should [fe'l]. I'm sure you would love it!
patterns.exampleEn: I think you should come here next year. I'm sure you would love it!
patterns.exampleUz: Menimcha, kelasi yili bu yerga kelishing kerak. Ishonchim komil, senga juda yoqadi!
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Xatni TAVSIYA bilan yakunlash qolipi.
⚠ 'should' + oddiy fe'l ('to' siz).

groups.explanationUz: 'smoked salmon' va 'stunning view' - ikkalasi ham fe'ldan yasalgan sifat, lekin MA'NOSI TESKARI.

items.note: ⚠ 'I am bored' (men zerikdim) va 'It is boring' (u zerikarli) - ADAShTIRMANG
⚠ 'a historic day' (muhim kun) va 'a historical novel' (tarixiy roman) - FARQI BOR
